header.running_head: Refraining from Killing Muslims and the Abomination of Fighting for Land

blocks.text: Whoever purposely murders a Mu'min (regarding his act as a permissible act), his punishment shall be Jahannam where he shall live forever. Allaah shall be angry with him, curse him and prepare for him a dreadful punishment.
The man then argued, "But Allaah also says:

blocks.arabic_text: وَقٰتِلُوْهُمْ حَتّٰى لَا تَكُوْنَ فِتْنَةٌ وَّيَكُوْنَ الدِّيْنُ كُلُّهٗ لِلّٰهِ
blocks.text: 'Fight them until no corruption exists and all religion (worship) is for Allaah.'?"
To this, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) replied, "We did that during the time of Rasulullaah ﷺ..." The narration then proceeds like the one quoted above.[^1]

Another narration adds that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) asked the man, "Do you know what is meant by 'corruption'? Muhammad ﷺ used to fight against the Mushrikeen and fighting them is (fighting) 'corruption'. It was nothing like how you fight nowadays for land.[^2]
What Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) said to Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA) and Ibn Safwaan (RA) Concerning his Reluctance to pledge allegiance to Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA)

Hadhrat Abul Aaliya Baraa reports that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Safwaan (RA) were one day sitting in the Hateem when Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) passed by while performing Tawaaf. One of them said to the other, "Do you think that there is anyone alive who is better than that man?" He then asked another man to call Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) when he had completed his Tawaaf. When Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) completed his Tawaaf and had performed the two Rakaahs, the messenger that the two Sahabah (RA) had sent approached him saying, "Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA) and Abdullaah bin Safwaan (RA) over there are calling for you." When Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) came to them, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Safwaan (RA) asked, "O Abu Abdur Rahmaan! What prevents you from pledging allegiance to the Ameerul Mu'mineen (Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA)) when the people of Makkah, Madinah, Yemen, Iraq and most of the people of Shaam have already pledged their allegiance to him?" Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) replied, "By Allaah! I shall never pledge my allegiance to you as long as the swords you hang over your necks are dripping with the blood of Muslims."[^3]
Bukhaari and Abu Nu'aym in his Hilya (Vol.1 Pg.292).
